activity_summary: Hobbins was in at the Bell. You gave him Susanna's letter, the one written on the twenty-sixth, at twopence. You sent no parcel and no money with it. He had nothing for you this time. No cheese, no glove, and no word for your hand.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the letter, paid twopence, and accepted an empty hand.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Took the letter at twopence, and had nothing to bring back.

entities.name: Susanna's letter
entities.context: Mentioned in Twopence, and nothing back
